name: @charlie.dev/waybackify-crawl
description: The wayback.charlie.dev completeness crawler — drives the `remaster verify` dynamic probe (strict-serving browser render, archive.org abort-routed) to a fixpoint, recording browser-discovered dynamic[] requisites until a render makes zero unexpected web.archive.org requests. Depends down on waybackify (facts) + waybackify-serve (the shared serving core); never on render/wayback.
author: Charlie Robbins <npm@charlie.dev>
